newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lebed to fly to Moscow as Chechnya talks delayed.
newsitem.headline: Lebed to fly to Moscow as Chechnya talks delayed.

text.p: Security chief Alexander Lebed will soon return from Chechnya to Moscow for consultations with the Russian leadership after talks on a political solution to the conflict were delayed, Itar-Tass news agency said on Sunday.

"Lebed said that the reason for the cancellation of today's negotiations was legal difficulties which arose while finalising the document," it said, adding that Lebed was speaking at a news conference at the Russian base near the Chechen capital.
